title.value: Aspirations and Practice of ML Model Documentation: Moving the Needle with Nudging and Traceability
title.justification: The paper's main focus is on the practices of documenting machine learning models and improving accountability and traceability through better documentation tools.
title.quote: Aspirations and Practice of ML Model Documentation: Moving the Needle with Nudging and Traceability

extractions.description: The paper examines the practices of documenting machine learning models, identifying gaps between existing documentation practices and proposed standards like model cards. It presents a tool called DocML designed to nudge data scientists towards better documentation practices, particularly in aspects related to ethics and accountability.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is improving the documentation practices of machine learning models to ensure accountability and prevent misuse, which does not directly relate to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The documentation practice for machine-learned (ML) models often falls short of established practices for traditional software, which impedes model accountability and inadvertently abets inappropriate or misuse of models.

primary_category.justification: The paper predominantly focuses on the documentation practices of machine learning models and does not directly address Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_category.quote: In this work, we systematically study the model documentation in the field and investigate how to encourage more responsible and accountable documentation practice.

secondary_categories.justification: Since the primary theme does not align with any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development category, it is unlikely to have secondary relevance to such categories.
secondary_categories.quote: While past work has already shown often limited documentation during model development, such as few markdown cells in public notebooks and missing README files in notebook repositories on GitHub.

primary_sub_category.justification: As there is no relevant primary category related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, no sub-category can be assigned.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our analysis of publicly available model cards reveals a substantial gap between the proposal and the practice.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Since the primary and secondary categories do not align with Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, no sub-categories apply.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We focus on external documentation of reusable ML models and services.

applications.justification: The paper discusses improving the quality and inclusivity of machine learning model documentation to ensure ethical considerations and accountability, which is an application of documentation tools to enhance ethical practices.
applications.quote: Our work makes the following contributions to understanding and supporting ML model documentation practice... A rubric for evaluating ML documentation, developed and used in our study based on model cards proposal.

new_primary_category.justification: The content of this paper is focused on model documentation practices and does not warrant a new Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development category.
new_primary_category.quote: Our study reveals the benefit of our tool towards long-term documentation quality and accountability.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no new Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development sub-category applicable since the focus is on documentation practices.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We design and implement a documentation tool for data scientists, named DocML.
